source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting a failed industrial safety audit

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
- Begin with a clear title: "Failed Industrial Safety Audit Report" and include the date of the audit. 

3. Identify the site and involved parties.
   - Clearly list the name and location of the industrial site being audited.
   - Name the company/organization involved.
   - List all individuals present during the audit, including the auditor(s), company representatives, safety officers, etc.

4. Summarize the audit scope and guidelines.
   - Briefly outline the scope of the audit including the areas and systems examined.
   - Specify the safety standards, regulations, and guidelines against which the audit was conducted.

5. Detail the areas of non-compliance.
   - Divide into sections based on the different areas audited (e.g., machinery safety, hazardous materials management, employee training, PPE usage, emergency protocols, etc.).
   - For each non-compliant area, provide a detailed description of the observed issues.
